part1a_home_shared_soundings.shared_definition: two reports of different labelled devices, same access point, same generation, same sounding dialog token, closer than 20 ms

part2_combined_defense.features: z-scored concatenation [320 angle values, 1 constant format column, mean and std of the stream-1 SNR byte]; snr_alone = the last two
part2_combined_defense.reference: pure noise of the same shape: r_rotation's null_noise table for the angle block, the same constant format column, i.i.d. standard normal SNR columns
part2_combined_defense.one_format_is_an_assumption: every window carries the same format; the enforceable policies of r_format_equalized leave more than one class

part1b_he_shared_sounding.protocol: He CR1, 19 held-out positions, cosine 1-NN, K = 1, T in [1, 32], 10 seeds, 200 decisions per class at T > 1
part1b_he_shared_sounding.feature: |v_a^H v_b| of the first columns per tone group (59 values), both reports quantised at 4-bit phi / 2-bit psi
part1b_he_shared_sounding.partner: a calibration position; random_report = a fresh partner report per sounding, fixed_report = one partner report for all

part3_dp_gsq.label: our implementation of a full-support variant (exponential mechanism over the 2^b cells of each angle), not the authors' code
part3_dp_gsq.mechanism: P(report cell j | true cell c) proportional to exp(-eps d(c, j) / (2 Delta)); phi: 16 cells, circular distance, Delta = 8; psi: 4 cells, linear distance, Delta = 3; eps-local-DP per angle (12 angles x 59 groups per report compose)
part3_dp_gsq.protocol: He CR1, 19 held-out positions, cosine 1-NN, K = 1, raw and scaled features, 10 seeds; gain on 3000 reports per seed against the continuous V
